摘要Abstract

我们研究离散采样的掩蔽扩散并引入 数据几何的路径解析测量称为We study masking diffusion for discrete sampling and introduce a path-resolved measure of data geometry called the揭露 增长复杂性unmasking growth complexity (教资会UGC）。其局部增量 直接控制 Kullback–Leibler (KL) 离散化误差，产生 伯努利子集和固定基数揭秘的统一分析 计划。在对数显示赔率坐标中，该结构产生 优化单块和多块调度，并量化 通过使计算工作适应数据几何而获得收益。至关重要的是， 我们展示如何). Its local increments directly control Kullback–Leibler (KL) discretization error, yielding a unified analysis of Bernoulli-subset and fixed-cardinality unmasking schemes. In log-reveal-odds coordinates, this structure yields optimized single-block and multi-block schedules, and quantifies the gains from adapting computational effort to data geometry. Crucially, we show how教资会UGC增量可以估计为 通过 KL 增量沿着耦合揭示轨迹进行样本。这个 导致increments can be estimated from samples via KL increments along coupled reveal trajectories. Collapsing the教资会UGC路径产生聚合path yields the aggregate教资会UGC质量，其中 连接到经典的多元依赖性度量和复杂性 来自先前离散扩散分析的测量值。在 细划分极限，平方根的平方积分mass, which connects to classical multivariate dependence measures, and complexity measures from previous analyses of discrete diffusion. In the fine-partition limit, the squared integral of the square-root教资会UGC密度决定尖锐的前导顺序 最优欧拉离散误差。例子展示了实质性的 粗略计划的维度相关增益，包括density determines the sharp leading-order optimal Euler discretization error. Examples exhibit substantial dimension-dependent gains over coarse schedules, includingΩ~​(d)\widetilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{d})持续改进可实现 自适应放置的块的数量。improvements achievable with a constant number of adaptively placed blocks.

1 简介Introduction

从高维分布中采样的问题是 本质上是基础性的，具有广泛的应用。 高效的采样算法支撑着蒙特卡罗的实用性 近似值The problem of sampling from a high-dimensional distribution is fundamental in nature, and has a wide range of applications. Efficient sampling algorithms underpin the utility of Monte Carlo approximation[39, 42];支持不确定性 贝叶斯模型中的量化; support uncertainty quantification in Bayesian models[18, 6];并撒谎 生成人工智能的核心; and lie at the heart of generative AI[40, 16, 54, 13]。近年来取得了巨大的实践和成果 扩散应用的理论进展. Recent years have witnessed tremendous practical and theoretical advances in the use of diffusion11 1全文 一般来说，扩散术语是用词不当，因为并非所有 这些模型涉及形式概率中的扩散过程 感觉；这包括本研究中研究的揭露模型 纸。尽管如此，我们还是采用传统术语。In full generality, the diffusion terminology is a misnomer, since not all such models involve a diffusion process in the formal probabilistic sense; this includes the unmasking models studied in this paper. Nonetheless, we adopt the conventional terminology.抽样 算法，通过一系列“去噪”生成样本 运营sampling algorithms, which generate samples via a sequence of “denoising” operations[45, 46, 23, 47, 14, 12, 5]。该领域的初步工作重点 从连续分布中抽样. Initial work in the area focused on sampling from continuous distributions ind，其中 在这种情况下，去噪步骤对应于估计嵌入的信号 高斯噪声, in which case the denoising step corresponds to estimating a signal embedded in Gaussian noise[23, 47]。最近的一项工作， 本文的总体重点是从 离散分布，使用各种去噪 流程. A more recent line of work, and the general focus of this paper, has focused on sampling from discrete distributions, using various kinds of denoising processes[24, 3, 9, 31, 44, 43, 15, 17].

在本文中，我们研究随机向量的采样问题In this paper, we study the problem of sampling a random vectorZ∈(𝒜)dZ\in(\mathcal{A})^{d}, 其中, where𝒜\mathcal{A}是一个离散的字母表，并且is a discrete alphabet, anddd是环境维度。虽然各种采样器已 设计，我们专注于is the ambient dimension. While various samplers have been devised, we focus on揭露采样器unmasking samplers，遍历一条路径 来自完全未观察到的向量，表示为, which traverse a path from a fully unobserved vector, denoted byZ∗=(⋆,…,⋆)Z^{*}=(\star,\ldots,\star)与with⋆\star意思是被掩盖或未被观察到，回到样本meaning masked or unobserved, back to a sampleZ∼ℙZZ\sim\mathbb{P}_{Z}从目标分布。路径是 通过一系列取消屏蔽操作进行遍历，其中的子集 隐藏的坐标被显示。解密算法的不同之处在于 这些揭露步骤发生的形式和顺序。 揭开和密切相关的基于掩模的生成采样器 经证明在一系列应用中有效，包括机器 翻译from the target distribution. The path is traversed via a sequence of unmasking operations, in which a subset of the masked coordinates are revealed. Unmasking algorithms differ in the form and sequence by which these unmasking steps take place. Unmasking and closely related mask-based generative samplers have proven effective across a range of applications, including machine translation[19]、图像和视频 合成, image and video synthesis[11, 55], 文本转图像 一代, text-to-image generation[10], 演讲 合成, speech synthesis[52], 语言 建模, language modeling[43, 33]，和蛋白质 设计, and protein design[51].

1.1 概述Overview

本文的动机是与以下两个相关的广泛问题： 扩散采样器，如我们关于高斯的配套论文中所述 扩散This paper is motivated by two broad questions associated with diffusion samplers, as articulated in our companion paper on Gaussian diffusion[50]，我们在这里解释一下：, which we paraphrase here:

问题一：Q1:掩蔽扩散采样的性能可以吗？ 一般而言，通过与以下相关的措施来解释和量化 数据几何？Can the performance of masked diffusion sampling be explained and quantified, in some generality, by a measure tied to data geometry?

问题2：Q2:是否有可能利用掩蔽扩散措施 用于设计、优化和验证实际采样的数据几何 计划？Is it possible to exploit a masked-diffusion measure of data geometry to design, optimize and certify practical sampling schemes?

最近的工作在这两个问题上都取得了实质性进展。陈等 等人。Recent work has made substantial progress on both questions. Chen et al.[15]分析固定基数揭露并得出 其预期 KL 的准确信息概况表示 离散化误差，对时间表设计和界限产生影响 基于总相关性和对偶总相关性。薰衣草和 扎内拉analyze fixed-cardinality unmasking and derive an exact information-profile representation of its expected KL discretization error, with consequences for schedule design and bounds based on total and dual total correlation. Lavenant and Zanella[25]导出信息概要表示 随机顺序揭露的因式分解误差，并研究 渐近缩放机制中的最优调度。来自不同的 方向，德米特里耶夫等人。derive an information-profile representation of the factorization error for random-order unmasking, and study optimal schedules in asymptotic scaling regimes. From a different direction, Dmitriev et al.[17]分析离散扩散 通过连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC) 公式；用于掩蔽 扩散，它们的修改analyze discrete diffusion via a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) formulation; for masking diffusion, their modifiedτ\tau- 跳跃式担保受 有效总相关性可以远小于 经典的最坏情况措施。总的来说，这些结果提供了 的重要答案-leaping guarantees are governed by an effective total correlation that can be substantially smaller than the classical worst-case measures. Collectively, these results provide important answers toQ1以及部分答案and partial answers toQ2，但是 缺乏学习和认证的有限样本保证 来自数据的几何自适应时间表。, but fall short of finite-sample guarantees for learning and certifying geometry-adaptive schedules from data.

我们的回答Our answer toQ1是基于is based on the揭露增长 复杂性unmasking growth complexity or 教资会UGC简而言之。它是数据的路径解析度量 揭示过程中的依赖性。我们证明它的局部增量 直接控制KL离散化误差，从而得到一个公共的 固定基数揭露和自然基数的分析 伯努利子集变体。当折叠在完整的显示路径上时， 的for short. It is a path-resolved measure of data dependence along the reveal process. We show that its local increments directly control KL discretization error, thereby obtaining a common analysis of both fixed-cardinality unmasking and a natural Bernoulli-subset variant. When collapsed over the full reveal path, the教资会UGC复杂性降低到紧密相连的粗略测量 经典的多元依赖性 措施complexity reduces to a coarse measure that closely connected to classical multivariate dependence measures[53, 21, 22, 48]，以及到 CTMC 中出现的有效全相关 分析, as well as to the effective total correlation appearing in the CTMC analysis[17]。因此，得到的单块 保证锐化现有的固定基数界限，同时给出 伯努利揭秘保证与 CTMC 的保证相当 采样器。. Consequently, the resulting single-block guarantees sharpen existing fixed-cardinality bounds while giving Bernoulli unmasking guarantees comparable to those available for CTMC samplers.

我们论文的主要贡献是在以下背景下The main contributions of our paper are in the context ofQ2, 特别是，我们使用完整的, and in particular, our use of the full教资会UGC设计的复杂性路径 并分析经过认证的最佳采样算法。更多 准确地说，我们表明complexity path to design and analyze sampling algorithms that are certified-optimal. More precisely, we show that教资会UGC复杂性有天然的添加剂 沿着揭示路径的结构，以便其局部增量可以是 从样本中估计并用于分配计算工作量，其中 目标分布是最难揭露的。我们利用这个 导出和优化分块调度的结构，构建 具有高概率 KL 证书的数据相关采样器，以及 最后，优化块边界本身。在 细分区限制，log-reveal-oddscomplexity has a natural additive structure along the reveal path, so that its local increments can be estimated from samples and used to allocate computational effort where the target distribution is most difficult to unmask. We exploit this structure to derive and optimize blockwise schedules, construct data-dependent samplers with high-probability KL certificates, and finally, to optimize the block boundaries themselves. In the fine-partition limit, the log-reveal-odds教资会UGC密度出现为 固有局部几何：其平方根积分决定 限制分区复杂性和尖锐的前序最优 欧拉离散化误差。density emerges as the intrinsic local geometry: its square-root integral governs the limiting partition complexity and the sharp leading-order optimal Euler discretization error.

1.2 相关工作Related work

为了将我们的结果放在上下文中，我们现在提供更广泛的 相关工作的讨论。离散型有多种类型 扩散模型，所有这些模型都取代了加性高斯噪声 随机腐败核的连续空间扩散 离散状态空间。早期的工作发展了多项等等 一般结构化离散扩散 流程So as to put our results in context, we now provide a broader discussion of related work. There are various types of discrete diffusion models, all of which replace the additive Gaussian noise for continuous-space diffusions by stochastic corruption kernels on discrete state spaces. Early work developed multinomial and more general structured discrete diffusion processes[24, 3]，其中吸收态 腐败是掩盖扩散过程的基础。其他 工作, among them the absorbing-state corruption that underlies a masking diffusion process. Other work[9]使用以下公式制定离散扩散模型 连续时间马尔可夫链的形式主义，以及后续工作 开发基于分数的建模的离散类似物，其中 反向CTMC通过学习概率参数化 比率formulated discrete diffusion models using the formalism of continuous-time Markov chains, with subsequent work developing discrete analogues of score-based modeling in which the reverse CTMC is parameterized through learned probability ratios[31]。掩模扩散尤为重要 子类，其中坐标被替换为 杰出的面具符号和生成过程是逐步进行的 重建屏蔽坐标. Masked diffusion is a particularly important subclass, in which coordinates are corrupted by replacement with a distinguished mask symbol and generation proceeds by progressively reconstructing masked coordinates[44, 43].

2 概述：揭示增长复杂性和抽样Overview: unmasking growth complexity and sampling

为了引导读者，我们首先提供一个高层次的概述 我们分析的主要思想和数量。我们首先 描述规范的揭露过程。使用它，我们定义 揭示增长的复杂性（So as to orient the reader, we begin by providing a high-level overview of the main ideas and quantities underlying our analysis. We first describe the canonical unmasking process. Using it, we define the unmasking growth complexity (教资会UGC），衡量信息量 难度沿着揭示路径分布。然后我们传递给 log-reveal-odds 坐标，其中复杂性由 密度，其几何形状决定采样工作量 沿路径分配。), which measures how informational difficulty is distributed along the reveal path. We then pass to log-reveal-odds coordinates, where this complexity is represented by a density whose geometry determines how sampling effort should be allocated along the path.

我们的目标主要是概念性的：解释其中的区别 在粗略计划和几何感知计划之间，以说明数据 的几何形状Our goal here is primarily conceptual: to explain the distinction between coarse and geometry-aware schedules, to illustrate the data geometry of the教资会UGC几个例子的密度，并预览如何 数据驱动的自适应分区可以利用这种几何形状。精确 我们对采样器、估算程序和的保证形式 支持的技术成果将在后续章节中制定。density on several examples, and to preview how data-driven adaptive partitioning can exploit this geometry. 在本文中，我们证明了揭示增长复杂性 (In this paper, we have shown that the unmasking growth complexity (教资会UGC）控制随机子集去掩码方案的性能， 并揭示了优化其性能所需的结构。它 是一种基于路径的测量，具有附加的局部增量，限制了 相应的KL离散化误差。揭晓赔率决定 有限揭露步骤的自然乘法尺度，使得 log-reveal-odds 适当的路径坐标。对数揭示赔率) controls the performance of random subset unmasking schemes, and reveals the structure required to optimize their performance. It is a path-based measure with additive local increments that bound the corresponding KL discretization errors. The reveal odds determine the natural multiplicative scale for a finite unmasking step, making log-reveal-odds the appropriate path coordinate. The log-reveal-odds教资会UGC密度给出了采样难度的局部描述：区域 携带很少density gives a local description of sampling difficulty: regions carrying little教资会UGC质量可以快速穿过大 步长，而质量集中的区域需要更小的步长 步长。我们通过以下方式正式确定了这一资源分配原则： 的概念mass can be traversed rapidly with large stepsizes, whereas regions of concentrated mass require smaller stepsizes. We formalized this resource-allocation principle via a notion of分区复杂度partition complexity。在一个极端情况下，它减少到 （粗略）单块复杂度；在逐步细化的过程中， 收敛到平方根的函数. At one extreme, it reduces to a (coarse) single-block complexity; under progressive refinement, it converges to a functional of the square root of the教资会UGC密度， 这也决定了最优的尖锐前导复杂度 预定欧拉离散化。density, which also determines the sharp leading-order complexity of optimally scheduled Euler discretization.

值得注意的是，本文不仅仅将底层几何视为 一个预言量。我们展示了如何Notably, this paper moves beyond treating the underlying geometry as an oracle quantity. We show how the教资会UGC增量可以可靠地 使用沿耦合揭示轨迹的 KL 增量进行估计。由 这样做，我们获得的采样方法是increments can be reliably estimated using KL increments along a coupled reveal trajectory. By doing so, we obtain sampling methods that are经认证的最佳certified-optimal，这意味着它们已获得认证（具有高 概率）来实现预先指定的 KL 误差，及其迭代 复杂度在最佳迭代的常数因子之内 复杂性。因此，我们的分析将扩散中的三个核心任务联系起来 采样：表征目标分布的几何形状， 设计抽样计划并验证抽样的准确性 由此产生的采样器。, meaning that they are certified (with high probability) to achieve a pre-specified KL error, and their iteration complexity is within a constant factor of the optimal iteration complexity. Thus, our analysis connects three core tasks in diffusion sampling: characterizing the geometry of the target distribution, designing a sampling schedule, and certifying the accuracy of the resulting sampler.

让我们记下一些重要的限定条件 结论。我们最强大的数据依赖保证依赖于访问 贝叶斯降噪器和 KL 增量的矩控制。与 学习降噪器，近似误差贡献了一个附加项 到 KL 保证，并且需要对其进行完全估计 经认证的保证。此外，我们的最优性概念是相对的 到冻结海报欧拉离散化。有可能的是 高阶离散化和其他更复杂的过程 可以接受不同的局部几何形状，因此有可能 用于步长分配的不同最佳时钟。Let us make note of some important qualifications to this conclusion. Our strongest data-dependent guarantees rely on access to Bayes denoisers and on moment control for their KL increments. With learned denoisers, approximation error contributes an additional term to the KL guarantee, and it needs to be estimated for a fully certified guarantee. Moreover, our notion of optimality is relative to frozen-poster Euler discretizations. It is possible that higher-order discretizations and other more sophisticated procedures could admit different local geometries, and hence potentially different optimal clocks for stepsize allocation.
